feeds.title: Parks Blogger
feeds.description: Hi, I am Sakthi. I love Ontario Parks and Camping. Thats how I started this website. What started as a simple blog featuring my own trip logs has grown into a trustable brand name across Ontario over the last 2 years. I now have fellow outdoor adventurers and campers in Ontario whom I can call 'friends' proudly because of what I am doing here and I also constantly feature their work here. Trip logs, Gear Reviews, Tips and Tricks….anything that interests campers and park lovers in Ontario.
